interpretation: The oceanic-island networks were species-poorer but were not uniformly interaction-poorer. Higher connectance and nestedness were attributed in the article to opportunistic and super-generalist species. This is consistent with reorganisation rather than one-dimensional network collapse.
claim_boundary: Abstract-level directions are not effect sizes and cannot be combined with Wanshan-Yongxing plant-level log response ratios. Supplementary matrices, metric values, uncertainty and effort must be recovered before quantitative geological-origin analysis.
